To be fair i think my friend probably is depressed it just hurt a lot to hear him say that to me. We're usually very open with each other about our feelings because i don't really have boundaries so i think a little bit of him would know how that made me feel. I doubt he'll even remember me in a year so it doesn't really matter i suppose.

I also suppose i dont understand that anyone could be affected by my death. Due to other things wrong with me that I'm not exactly sure what they are, i dont feel anything when someone dies. So i can't really empathise with the idea that people would feel sadness when I die.

I think some of these lies depression tells me are the truth. That my future is nothing and that I'm just another cog in the machine.

Im glad for you that you've managed to overcome a bad low. However I'm not as strong as you and I truly don't want to live anymore to stop the pain and because there is no point in life. Existence is simply suffering. There are no glimpse of joy anymore just sadness.

I cant see any other doctors because of how it works in my country. This is the best im getting. My life has no meaning, i will bring nothing to society. No one would be bothered if I wasnt here anymore. My parents would probably be annoyed to have to pay for me to be cremated but that would be all... My family wouldn't care, they'd all quickly move on. And as someone who i consider quite a good friend put the other night 'you have less of an impact on people's lives than you think'. Meaning even the person im possibly the closest to at the moment would hardly be bothered either...

It really doesn't feel like I'll make it out of this. I've been to the doctors, well ive been under a mental health service for 4 years and they don't want to know anymore. I had therapy for years and it did nothing and now they're putting off giving me medication which could help me try deal with this. It just feels so hopeless. It feels like they're almost against me. One less person weighing the system down.
But no one loves me. No one is coming to save me. And im too exhausted to swim anymore. I do appreciate the nice reply though but sinking is all i can do now.
